anchorGroupPractitionerId.description: The anchor group practitioner this run belongs to.

status.description: The derived shared status. Seven persisted values; Closed is display-only.

active.description: Whether the run is still open to new joins.

mixedComposition.description: True when the members disagree about the cycle.

credentialingDueDate.description: Earliest recredentialing date across the non-terminal members.

openMemberCount.description: Members still open, as the rollup counted them.

firstPsvCompleteAt.description: When the first member reached PSV Complete. Write-once: it latches on the first member to get there and is never moved by a later one.

nextCredentialingDate.description: The next credentialing date for the run.

previousCredentialingDate.description: The previous credentialing date for the run.

syncedAt.description: When the rollups were last derived.
